what: _SCRIPT_RE's unquoted prefix crossed from the interpreter's drive letter over the spaces to src\, so every absolutely-pathed STANDING job read as a foreign tree and restart_reader / kill_stalled_job / kill_duplicate_jobs were no-ops.
how: Prefix alternation: a quoted path must open right after its quote ((?<=")...[^"]*?), an unquoted one may not contain whitespace ([^"\s]*?); groups 1/2/3 unchanged so _foreign_tree and kill_duplicate_jobs read it as before. Net builds rows from overnight.STANDING via list2cmdline([pythonw, '-u', *args]) under a space-free and a spaced interpreter, plus sandbox copies (with and without spaces) that must stay foreign; drives restart_reader and kill_duplicate_jobs with os.kill captured. Old drill nets _dedupe_ends_only_a_true_twin and _no_unrestartable_kill still HELD.

what: _dedup_fetch._key stripped everything outside [a-z0-9], so non-Latin titles keyed to '' and were dropped before any counter, and macron folding mapped Okami onto Kami.
how: _key is now NFKD + isalnum (backfill._name_key semantics), falling back to the stripped case-folded title when it has no alphanumerics; only a blank title is skipped. Removed the now-unused `import re`. Existing drill net _net_0173de67d95a still HELD.

All 16 drill_codewatch nets still HELD.
